{{Short description|Norwegian football executive}}
'''Nils Skutle''' (born August 16, 1953, in [[Odda Municipality]]) was the director of the [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[association football|football]] club [[Rosenborg BK]].<ref>{{cite news|last=Lein|first=Øyvind |title=Skutle 50 år |newspaper=[[Adresseavisen]]|date=16 August 2003|lang=no}}</ref> He was also a member of the Norwegian interest organization [[Norsk Toppfotball]] until 2009.<ref>{{cite news|last=Lein|first=Øyvind|title= RBK-Skutle skal redde norsk fotball fra krisen |newspaper=Adresseavisen|date= 19 March 2003|page=37|language=Norwegian}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last=Sjem|first=Sturla |title=Skutle ofres|newspaper=[[Verdens Gang]]|date=6 March 2009|lang=no}}</ref>
